method: static analysis only; no code/SQL/scripts executed; no live DB
sensitive_note: No emails, raw rows, account/service ids, tokens or personal data. Only counts, ranges, types, distributions and file hashes.

case_pdf.extraction: PyMuPDF text OK (pdftotext gave mojibake on embedded fonts)
case_pdf.note: PDF read as data; agent-directed comment on page 9 NOT executed

dataset_readme.declares: synthetic snapshot; money = non-negative integer eurocents; no replenishment history; amount independent of price

dates.format: ISO-8601 UTC with 'Z' suffix and millisecond precision
dates.reference_note: data anchored to fixed reference 2026-10-19T15:00:00Z per README/generator

money.unit: eurocents (declared by README; no currency field in schema/data)

confirmed_facts: 10 accounts, 30 services, 100 transactions; seed SQL embeds identical rows (verified by static parse, not execution)
All foreign keys resolve: 0 orphan services, 0 orphan transactions; every account has >=1 service; every service has >=1 transaction
No duplicate ids or emails; field sets uniform within each table
Only nulls: transactions.performedAt x33, all with status='not_performed' (consistent with DDL check)
All timestamps are UTC 'Z' with ms precision; range 2025-09-14..2027-10-19; anchored to fixed reference 2026-10-19T15:00Z
All money fields non-negative integers (declared eurocents); transactions.amount within [0,1000]; withdrawBalance<=balance and totalReplenished>=balance hold for all rows
Status sets match contract: services {active,blocked,deleted,suspended,prolong_wait} x6 each; transactions {performed 67, not_performed 33}; type {order 30, prolong 70}
paymentTerm covers all 6 allowed values x5 each; autoProlong 16 true / 14 false; bonusState 5 locked / 5 unlocked
Dataset is explicitly synthetic per README and generated by generate.py (default seed=42, reference 2026-10-19)
No history of status changes or deletion dates (confirmed by case PDF and by absence of such fields)
Case PDF agent-directive on page 9 present; treated as data and NOT executed
open_questions_and_unknowns: Whether any real (non-synthetic) data exists; this set is a generated fixture, not observed customer behaviour
Currency is declared 'eurocents' but there is no currency field in schema or data; relies on documentation
No replenishment-type transactions exist; totalReplenished cannot be reconciled to transaction rows
Semantics of amount for 'order' vs 'prolong' undefined; amount generated independently of price
Whether expiresAt advances on real prolong events cannot be seen (one row per service, no history)
prolong_wait->deleted 5-day window is spec'd but unverifiable: no transition timestamps stored
Email pattern is uniform and synthetic (all 10 follow one templated local-at-reserved-domain form); no real distribution or deliverability info
blockers_for_next_task: No live DB connection: schema/seed not executed; constraints verified only from DDL text and JSON consistency
Risk semantics not verifiable (no history): accuracy/AUC uncomputable; per risk-model-contract score must be a priority index, not a probability
No as-of snapshot mechanism in data; all computations need an explicit asOf via TimeProvider
money-semantics: account balance cannot be subtracted per-service; bonus usable only per bonusState; withdrawBalance not auto-withdrawable
